newsitem.title: USA: CBOT 10-year note futures set daily volume record.
newsitem.headline: CBOT 10-year note futures set daily volume record.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade 10-year U.S. Treasury note futures traded a record 276,932 contracts on Friday, surpassing the old record of 247,021 set February 26, the exchange said Monday.

"The record volume in our 10-year T-note contract reflects its growing use by foreign risk managers accustomed to financial instruments in the 10-year range," CBOT Chairman Pat Arbor said in a statement.
He also said the London Financial Futures and Options Exchange's 10-year Bund contract that recently began trading on the CBOT floor provided a new spreading opportunity.
